messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem — feature-flag rollout caused a latency spike and partial KV cache thrash. we need concrete remediation owners and timelines.

leo: saw the same. request logs show large fanout to background workers after flag flip. short-term guardrail = restrict audience % and a hard concurrency cap.

anika: i can own an auto-rollback experiment. plan: implement abort criteria + rollback hook in our flag lib. ETA 14 days for a working experiment.

jordan: i'll take blast-radius controls at infra level — limit number of hosts a flag can target and add a circuit-breaker to stop propagation. 10d ETA.

sam: i'll add canary traffic shaping and health-based ramping in the rollout service. can have a first pass in 7 days.

ops-bot: created follow-up ticket: FF-1279 "flag-safety-auto-rollback" assigned to anika.

maya: owners + rough deadlines: anika/14d, jordan/10d, sam/7d, leo/5d. i'll own tracking and weekly sync.

anika: POC plan: simulate flag flips at 2x peak QPS for 30m to validate abort thresholds and ensure KV cache stability. will add test harness.

leo: i'll add a presubmit linter/warning for wide audience targets in flag definitions (e.g. targeting >20% without an explicit canary plan). filing PR today.

jordan: recommend mandatory kill-switch path for every flag (fast path to 0) and prefer incremental audience buckets (1%, 5%, 25%).

sam: monitoring suggestions: tie flag-tagged requests to a dashboard and create SLO alert: if (5xx_rate or p50_latency) increases by X% in rolling 5m after flag change -> auto-pause rollout.

maya: i'm adding all actions to the postmortem follow-up doc and linking tracker (https://redwood.atlassian/FF-1279). weekly sync scheduled.

anika: draft rollback policy posted in doc: conditions = error_rate > 0.5% AND latency_delta > 30% over baseline with min 1k requests. open to tuning.

leo: PR for presubmit checks: draft in repo, PR #4527. requested reviews from @anika and @jordan.

ops-bot: reminder — follow-up sync Thu 10:00 PT (weekly) added to calendar.

maya: great progress. please paste PR/issue links in the tracker once created. we'll close this thread after all owners link artifacts. :thumbsup:
